newsitem.title: USA: Huntsman MTBE unit back up 90 pct on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Huntsman MTBE unit back up 90 pct on Wednesday.

text.p: The downed MTBE unit at Huntsman Corp's propylene oxide/methyl tertiary butyl ether (PO/MTBE) plant will be back online at 90 percent capacity on Wednesday morning, the company said Tuesday.
The Port Neches, Texas, MTBE unit went down last week for unscheduled maintenance to fix an operational problem.
The company said one of the plant's two reactors will be back up Wednesday morning producing 90 percent of the MTBE unit's rated capacity of 16,000 barrels per day.
The second reactor is expected to return on line by Thursday, the company added.
"A new catalyst should be put in the second reactor by Wednesday night or Thursday morning and the plant will be (fully) producing MTBE," said the company source.
Huntsman recently bought the PO/MTBE plant from Texaco Inc. but has operated the site since it opened August 1994.
